content: Framework ships 28 agent definitions in Rudra_Agents/*.md; the registry parses them into AgentSpec.
Budgetary Control, Employee Expense Management and Advanced Collections are out of scope for the Sprott foundational phase.
Sprott project follows a design-by-exception, configuration-first approach; custom extensions only for critical gaps.
Judge 'done' against fresh evidence (test output, reconciliation tie-out), not the agent's own summary.
Anything irreversible (posting journals, deleting data, sending to a client or regulator) waits for human approval.
Route small-answer-space decisions (which memories, which model tier, safe to run, done, keep/drop) to rules or a cheap model; reserve the frontier model for judgment-heavy content.
Deliverables are Big 4 / SI consulting grade: executive summary first, then detail, with sources cited.
